_input_doc: Path to input .npz file containing CT scan data with label and intensity arrays
_label_key_doc: Array key in .npz file that contains material labels (used to exclude voids/air)
_intensity_key_doc: Array key in .npz file that contains grey-level intensities for modulus mapping
_bins_doc: Number of histogram bins for discretising intensity levels (default: 256)
_exclude_labels_doc: List of label values to exclude (e.g., [0, 255] excludes void and air). Set to [] to include all labels
_output_doc: Path to save histogram plot image (PNG). Set to null to display on screen instead
_E_matrix_doc: Young's modulus of matrix phase (GPa). Example: 1.8 for PA66 polymer matrix
_E_fibre_doc: Young's modulus of fibre phase (GPa). Example: 72.0 for glass fibres
_fibre_fraction_doc: Target fibre volume fraction (0.0–1.0). Example: 0.30 for 30% glass-fibre-reinforced composite
_exponent_doc: Exponent for geometric (power-law) mixing rule. Only used when mixing='geometric'. Typical range: 0.5–2.0
_mixing_doc: Mixing rule for composite Young's modulus. Options: 'geometric' (power-law, default), 'voigt' (stiff bound), 'reuss' (compliant bound)
